newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: South Port accepts in principle Reid bid.
newsitem.headline: South Port accepts in principle Reid bid.

text.p: Southland Farmers Ltd (a wholly owned subsidiary of South Port New Zealand Ltd) on Monday confirmed it had accepted in principle an offer from Reid Farmers for the core Southland Farmers Ltd Stock and Station business -- wool brokering, merchandising/trading, livestock and seasonal financing.
The offer is conditional on Reid Farmers satisfactorily completing due diligence.
The motor vehicle and machinery division of Southland Farmers along with Insurance Brokers Alliance Ltd are not part of the core rural servicing activities and not included in the offer from Reid.
"South Port New Zealand is pleased with the overall outcome in that it is a further step in retargeting its own core activities," South Port said in a statement.
"Reid Farmers is pleased to confirm an increase in their involvement in the Southland area and to further reinforce their commitment and confidence in the rural sector," Reid said.

Reid Farmers would look to build on the expanded client base and the merging of the two businesses would result in a stronger company better able to handle the challenges of the future for clients, staff and shareholders alike.
